Alex — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

1) Recap
- You and the BrightBridge team want faster inference for your realtime personalization pipeline and tighter cost visibility across endpoints.
- Key success criteria we heard: 75ms p99 for simple completion paths, integration with your SSO/KMS, and a predictable monthly unit cost for peak periods.

2) Proposal: 30-minute product intro + short ops Q&A. Goal is to show the runtime, routing policies, and how we handle KV/prefix caching for your workload.

3) Time options - please pick one preferred slot or propose a counter: 
- Option A: Tue, Nov 10 — 10:00-10:30 PT
- Option B: Wed, Nov 11 — 11:00-11:30 PT
- Option C: Thu, Nov 12 — 14:00-14:30 PT

4) Prep asks from our side (one-pager attached):
- A short list of 2 example API calls / prompt shapes you want us to demo
- Any network constraints (VPC peering, egress rules) we should know in advance

I attached a one-pager with the suggested mutual action plan and a quick checklist. Kim is looped in for commercial details; we will bring Soojin from security for the ops Q&A if you want.

Attachments: aditya-demo-onepager.pdf (overview), BrightBridge-MAP.pdf (MAP stub)

Thanks — happy to lock something in.

Best,
